name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=ai, descriptor=score_offensive_spell. Function scores every castable offensive spell over every reachable cast tile and records the best into the ai_best_spell_* globals (no execution). Name accurately reflects purpose; no Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Enemy AI offensive-spell planner: scores every castable spell x every reachable cast tile and writes the single best candidate (score, target tile, spell id) into the ai_best_spell_* globals.
logic_summary: Resets ai_best_spell_score to 0 and preloads the job-0 movement-cost table. Builds the caster's castable spell list (fd2_build_usable_spell_list); bails if empty or the caster is silenced (pCaster[0x27]!=0). For each spell whose MP cost (pSpell[5]) <= caster MP, flood-fills the caster's movement range (range=pSpell[3]), enumerates reachable tiles, and for each tile computes AoE targets (shape=pSpell[4]; aoe arg selected via ctx_flag and pSpell[6]) then scores via fd2_score_spell_candidate. A candidate replaces the running best when its score is strictly greater, or equal with a higher spell base damage (*(uint16*)pSpell) tiebreak, updating ai_best_spell_score/_target_x/_target_y/_id. Frees the tile buffer; returns 0 (declared void in src).

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: runtime_char index of the casting enemy; used to index data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr to read position, MP (offset 0x44), and the silence status byte (offset 0x27), and passed to fd2_build_usable_spell_list.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_1; actual role is the caster runtime-char index. src already names it caster_idx.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: AoE-shape selector. When 0, the spell's pSpell[6] AoE byte is inverted to a 0/1 flag (pSpell[6]==0 ? 1 : 0); when non-zero, pSpell[6] is passed through to fd2_compute_aoe_targets. Propagated from the AI turn dispatcher's context argument.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_2; actual role is the AI context flag that selects AoE-shape argument handling. src already names it ctx_flag, consistent with sibling fd2_ai_score_item_use and the dispatcher callers.

returns.semantics: No meaningful return (Ghidra shows undefined4 returning constant 0; src declares void). Output is side-effect via the ai_best_spell_* globals.

comment_original_issue: Original src block was a 2-line summary that omitted the specific output globals/addresses, the ctx_flag AoE-shape semantics, the silence gate, and the tiebreak rule.
notes: src logic verified equivalent to Ghidra decompile (score comparison a<b vs b>a and tiebreak are mirror-equivalent; signed comparisons consistent with int32 global). RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50 matches runtime_char indexing. Minor non-blocking note: Ghidra plate labels the chosen-spell global 'active_spell_id @ 0x53C2F' while the live symbol is data_fd2_battle_ai_best_spell_id; plate is otherwise accurate and not contradictory, so left unchanged per src-as-source-of-truth rule.
